svg.title: ZOX — the Enterprise AI Brain
svg.desc: ZOX by INZOX: sovereign, air-gapped enterprise AI. A four-layer stack — Data, Intelligence, Reasoning, Decision — runs inside the customer perimeter with zero data egress. Four engines: Business Intelligence Brain, Strategic Reasoning Engine, Scenario Simulation and Sovereign Architecture.

g.text: A private AI platform that ingests your data,
reasons over it and returns decisions —
running entirely on hardware you control.
test the decision before you live it
NO OUTBOUND CALL · ZERO DATA EGRESS
